headline: 3 sentenced to death for killing AIUB student in Narayanganj
summary: A court has awarded the capital punishment to three muggers for the murder of a university student.
details: A court in Narayanganj has sentenced three muggers to death for the killing of an American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB) student.
The verdict was delivered by the Narayanganj District and Sessions Judge's Court.
The convicted individuals were found guilty of murdering the student during a mugging attempt.
The court's decision comes after a detailed trial regarding the brutal killing of the university student.

headline: 915 dead as 7 more die from measles symptoms in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a surge in measles-related deaths, with a total of 915 fatalities since March 15.
details: Seven people died within the last 24 hours due to measles symptoms, according to a regular report by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) released Monday.
The deaths occurred between Sunday 8 AM and Monday 8 AM. This brings the total death toll from measles symptoms to 816, and confirmed measles deaths to 99, totaling 915 since March 15.
In the last 24 hours, 981 new cases of measles symptoms were reported nationwide. Since March 15, the total number of patients with measles symptoms has reached 143,778.
The DGHS also reported 50 new confirmed measles cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the total number of confirmed cases since March 15 to 17,930.
A total of 125,386 patients with measles symptoms have been admitted to hospitals since March 15, with 120,913 having been discharged.
Of the seven deaths in the last 24 hours, five occurred in the Dhaka division, while one death was reported in Mymensingh and one in Barishal.
Epidemiologists note that while measles can affect people of all ages, children are the most severely affected during outbreaks.
